questions.unit: Organisms and Populations: Population attributes – birth and death rate, age pyramids;
questions.stem:
Consider the following statements about population interactions.
A. Interspecific competition can occur even when resources are plentiful, if one species interferes with the feeding of the other.
B. Predators act as conduits for transferring energy fixed by plants to higher trophic levels.
